Established in 1997, Pyramid Designer Glassware and Gifts is justifiably recognised as one of this country’s leading independent glassware retailers, offering customers an outstanding selection in design and quality.

Saso and Alex, the visionary founders of Pyramid Glass, have established themselves as the go-to destination for the most exquisite designer glassware and gifts.
